status: prospective protocol for material not yet analyzed; not a completed validation

already_examined: 404 Mustoe-2018 mirror-derived coding windows in three target conditions
20 overlapping PAIR-MaP windows at two E. coli loci
first24 discovery windows in heat-rank and exact roughness-matched control pilot
discovery_boundary.interpretation: all are discovery, robustness or model sensitivity; none is newly prospective independent biological validation of the emerging connectivity hypothesis
metadata_only: FoldAtlas article and repository inventory, one unrestrained example displayed in help
Cambray reporter data inventory and first503 complete rows
discovery_boundary.no_relabeling: Previously inspected PAIR-MaP outcomes cannot be relabeled as validation of a hypothesis formulated after seeing those outcomes

hypotheses.H1: A fixed standard peptide plus simultaneous allowed-pair constraints has no hidden same-signature point-mutation obstruction; its biological application requires independently supported obligations, not merely a union of hypothesized mutually exclusive folds
hypotheses.H2: Folding retention fields preserve connectivity beyond an uncorrelated score-permutation reference on the same complete local graph
hypotheses.H3_stronger_at_risk: The all-threshold organization exceeds that of generic smooth graph fields after controlling the component-specific score distribution and local edge roughness
hypotheses.interpretation_rule: If H3 fails, retain H2 only as generic score-geometry organization; do not claim RNA-specific adaptation, selection or a universal biological protection principle

prospective_material.source_gate: An independent original probing study with exact transcript sequences, reference-version-matched complete CDS annotation, unambiguous original or explicitly reconstructed partner tables, known measurement conditions, and usable source terms
prospective_material.priority: nonviral cross-species probing source; choose by the source gate before evaluating accessibility outcomes
prospective_material.negative_gate: If no qualifying source is recovered, report independent validation as unavailable rather than replacing it with another target model of the discovery cohort
prospective_material.fixed_example_exclusion: Any example structure already inspected during source recovery is excluded from the prospective cohort

selection.coverage: at least12 of15 finite probing values; negative finite values count as observed
selection.genetic_code: standard internal code only; fix initiator and stop, exclude recoding and overlapping-CDS variable bases
selection.sampling: one smallest-key eligible block per CDS, then first48 distinct nonoverlapping transcript units by smallest key, all selected outcomes retained
selection.resource_failures: log before folding; never interpret a sampled or truncated graph as disconnected

independence_and_leakage.source: study and measurement provenance independent from both Mustoe studies
independence_and_leakage.overlap: reject exact15nt variable-sequence and150nt-context duplicates of discovery; group overlapping windows and alternate transcript isoforms from the same locus
independence_and_leakage.sequence_relation: screen150nt contexts for local alignments covering at least100nt with at least80percent identity to discovery contexts; flag or exclude before scoring
independence_and_leakage.homology_limit: absence of shared local sequence is not proof of unrelated full-length proteins or phylogenetic independence; report annotated homologous families and species explicitly
independence_and_leakage.models: no prediction model trained on discovery outcomes; heat-time nuisance calibration is performed per graph by the frozen algorithm and is not evidence of held-out functional prediction

primary_endpoint.name: integrated extra fragmentation
primary_endpoint.definition: integral over threshold0to1 of E_F(threshold), with zero integrand where the selected set is empty; baseline compatibility components held fixed
primary_endpoint.comparison: mean generic-reference-minus-observed integral over all selected graphs; primary correlation-aware heat-rank reference, 199 evaluation draws following independent64-draw nuisance calibration
primary_endpoint.controls: uncorrelated within-component score permutation; coarse degree-conditioned cutoff control; exhaustive roughness-matched score permutations when resource gate permits
primary_endpoint.success: positive contrast with a95percent cluster interval excluding zero, AND no material explanation by heat-fit mismatch/influential cluster; exact conditional control is corroborative only where informative
primary_endpoint.failure: contrast consistent with zero, sign reversal, fit failure that prevents the comparison, or disappearance under an adequately matched control
primary_endpoint.supporting: longest positive persistence interval, local roughness, empty-set rates and primary0.5-cutoff summaries; no selection of a favorable threshold

uncertainty.cluster: 10000 resamples of independent transcript/locus units with seed2689; these quantify variation across the sampled modeled transcript collection
uncertainty.monte_carlo: report conditional simulation error separately from cluster variation
uncertainty.model: report context/engine/target-table changes separately; bootstrap does not quantify structural-model correctness
uncertainty.biological: do not interpret transcript resampling as biological-replicate or population-evolution uncertainty

robustness.thresholds: full critical-value filtration, no threshold tuning
robustness.influence: leave-one-transcript-cluster-out contrast and top1/top5cluster exclusions declared sensitivities; report every sign change
robustness.context: 210nt and300nt where source boundaries permit on the same selected blocks, with availability denominator explicit
robustness.engine: ViennaRNA2.7.2 Turner2004 and independent RNAstructure6.6 at310.15K; no mutant probing restraints
robustness.target_uncertainty: separate published partner tables or documented reconstruction alternatives; arbitrary unions are not treated as occupied joint folds

claims_not_tested: joint physical occupancy of a multiple-partner graph
